001package org.clafer.ast;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.clafer.common.Check;
005import org.clafer.common.Util;
006
007/**
008 *
009 * @author jimmy
010 */
011public record AstQuantify(Quantifier quantifier, AstDecl[] decls, AstBoolExpr body) implements AstBoolExpr {
012
013    public AstQuantify {
014        quantifier = Check.notNull(quantifier);
015        decls = Check.noNullsNotEmpty(decls);
016        body = Check.notNull(body);
017    }
018
019    @Override
020    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
021        return obj instanceof AstQuantify other && quantifier == other.quantifier
022                && Arrays.equals(decls, other.decls) && body.equals(other.body);
023    }
024
025    @Override
026    public int hashCode() {
027        return quantifier.ordinal() ^ Arrays.hashCode(decls) ^ body.hashCode();
028    }
029
030    @Override
031    public String toString() {
032        return quantifier.getSyntax() + " " + Util.commaSeparate(decls) + " | " + body;
033    }
034
035    public static enum Quantifier {
036
037        All("all"),
038        Lone("lone"),
039        None("no"),
040        One("one"),
041        Some("some");
042        private final String syntax;
043
044        private Quantifier(String syntax) {
045            this.syntax = syntax;
046        }
047
048        public String getSyntax() {
049            return syntax;
050        }
051    }
052}
